title: RSVP ERP dataset for authentication from Zhang et al 2025
description: A longitudinal EEG dataset of event-related potentials recorded with a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) paradigm for EEG-based identity authentication. Fifteen healthy participants viewed streams of face images, with their own face as the target and AI-generated faces as non-targets. Recordings were made over four sessions spanning about 200 days, using 57 channels sampled at 1000 Hz.
methods_description: 57-channel EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz with a Neuracle Neusen system (reference CPz, ground AFz). Each session comprised 4 blocks of 8 sequences of 200 face images, presented at a 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony. Targets were the participant's own face and non-targets were AI-generated faces. Four sessions were collected per subject over 200 days.
